## Projects

### Bite X (Restaurant App)

Full-stack restaurant platform — mobile app for customers and a web CMS for staff, managers, and admins.

Stack: React Native, Expo, React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, Supabase, Paystack, Redux Toolkit

Features: Auth, menu browsing, cart & orders, profile & Paystack payments, web CMS dashboard

Role: Built the Expo mobile app (Redux Toolkit) and React 19 CMS; Supabase auth, RLS, order flow, Paystack on both clients.

Links: https://restaurant-app-azure-theta.vercel.app/

### Kop & Chill Barbers (Barbershop Booking Hub)

A modern, high-performance B2C web platform for Polokwane's premier grooming lounge. Serves as a fast, accessible, and responsive booking hub with custom scheduling.

Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, @hugeicons/react, Vercel

Features: Dynamic Booking Calendar with availability management, validated customer checkout form with strict South African cell validation, WhatsApp Checkout Engine for auto-generating pre-filled booking details, premium flat shadow design language with Poppins typography.

Role: Designed and built the Next.js 15 App Router structure, step-by-step booking logic, WhatsApp checkout engine, custom South African cell validation, and local SEO optimizations.

Links: https://kop-and-chill-barbers.vercel.app/

### Mabotja Thabo Attorneys Inc. (Law Firm Website)

Marketing website for a Polokwane-based law firm (team project).

Stack (Andile's scope): Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript, Zod, Formspree, JSON-LD, Vercel

Contributions: App Router and src/data folder structure; per-page SEO metadata; sitemap.ts and robots.ts; JSON-LD schema; AEO via public llms.txt; /api/contact with Zod → Formspree. UI by others.

Role: Backend and discoverability — not visual UI design or front-end styling

Links: https://www.mabotjatinc.com

### A&TY Trade & Services (Cleaning & Trade Website)

Marketing website for a South African cleaning, mobile car wash, hygiene supplies, and trade services company serving Polokwane, Giyani, and Pretoria.

Stack: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, React Hook Form, Lucide, JSON-LD, Vercel

Features: Multi-page site; 11 service detail routes; products; quote & contact forms; gallery & testimonials; local SEO; WhatsApp CTA

Role: Full-stack marketing site — App Router, content architecture, forms, JSON-LD, Vercel deployment

Links: https://www.atytradeservices.co.za/

### Thusa (TUT Student Assistant)

AI-powered student support for Tshwane University of Technology — grounded chat with hybrid FAQ retrieval.

Stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, Node.js, Express, Supabase, OpenAI, Vercel AI SDK

Features: Streaming chat, hybrid FAQ search, conversation memory, scheduled TUT updates agent

Role: Full-stack — chat UI, API & retrieval, Supabase schema/seed, anti-hallucination prompts

Links: https://thusa-tut-ai-chatbot.vercel.app/

### OnSite (Municipality Maintenance)

AI-powered maintenance and employment system with incident reporting, classification, and worker assignment.

Stack: React, Flutter, Firebase Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions, Vision API, Figma

Features: Image-based reporting, AI classification & fraud detection, worker assignment, mobile + admin dashboard

Role: Full-stack features, Flutter workflows, Firebase integration, classification pipelines

### Weather App (OpenWeatherMap)

Real-time weather for any city — temperature, humidity, conditions, responsive icons.

Stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, OpenWeatherMap API

Links: https://weather-app-zeta-navy-82.vercel.app/
